title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: Meja Tanpa Laci
overview: This film highlights the life of a young police officer named Dipa, who chooses to remain honest amid a bureaucracy that has long been accustomed to bribery practices.

title: Hajatan Setan
overview: A young woman returns to her hometown after being away for years. However, her homecoming reopens old wounds and triggers a series of strange events that slowly engulf the villagers in suspicion and fear.

title: Yang Datang dan Yang Pergi
overview: Sinta (Dian Sastrowardoyo), the only daughter of Hartini (Retno Soetarto), inherits the family’s old Wiryo Guest House, a place that holds many memories from the past to the present. Amid the comings and goings of guests, Sinta is reunited with Banawan (Roy Sungkono), her childhood friend and the man she once loved. However, the presence of several other male guests brings with it hope, love, and betrayal, which slowly drag Sinta and her family into various problems.

title: 3726 MDPL
overview: For four years, Rangga only dared to greet Andini through a phone screen. Mount Rinjani and its 3,726-meter peak become witnesses to his courage as he finally confesses the sincerity of his feelings. Andini welcomes his love, but behind her smile, doubt lingers. Bintang, the ex-boyfriend who once caused her deepest heartbreak, returns with regret, a changed attitude, and a declaration of love that is just as sincere. Along a climbing trail that tests both body and mind, Andini faces the biggest question of her life: move forward with someone new, or turn back to resolve the unfinished memories of the past?

title: Sara
overview: Sara, a transgender woman goes back to her remote hometown to attend her father’s funeral. She finds the village has changed greatly, and that the villagers have become extremely religious. Added to that, her mother suffers from dementia and treats her like a complete stranger.

title: Pok Ame Ame
overview: Tells the story of a child who was left in a disabled state after a brutal murder killed her entire family while on vacation at a villa. After that, the girl suddenly gained mystical powers and made her seek revenge against everyone who was considered to be related to the murder case, including the teenagers, one of whom turned out to be the killer.

title: Jani Be Good
overview: Ten days after her sister Julia leaves home without a word, Jani (13) wants only one thing: her return. Jani knows her mother, Winnie, is the reason Julia left, and the two are growing distant while Winnie buries her guilt in work. Only Oma, the grandmother, comforts Jani. Unknown to Winnie and Oma, Jani secretly keeps in touch with Julia. Over four December days, Jani must choose: stay silent or confront her mother.

title: 12 Mile: Guiding the Archipelago
overview: A documentary film about Prof. Mochtar Kusumaatmadja.

title: ARSIP 07: Rekaman Yang Tidak Pernah Dipublikasikan
overview: Four content creator friends—Raka, Naya, Kevin, and Bima—who love exploring horror, decide to visit a mysterious building known as the Three-Story Building, a building without doors, windows, or rooms that stands in the middle of a rice paddy. With their cameras as witnesses, they intend to prove that the haunted stories circulating are just myths.  However, from the moment they enter the building, various illogical events begin to haunt them. Mysterious voices, a dark figure visible only through the camera, and illusions of space and time trap them in an inexplicable terror. When the exit seemingly disappears and the footage begins to show a different reality, they realize that something has been watching them from the beginning.  ARSI 07: Unpublished Footage is a mockumentary and found footage horror film that creates suspense through seemingly real footage, with an ending that leaves the question: did they really escape, or have they become part of the archives forever lost?

title: Avengers: Doomsday
overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

title: What They Left Us
overview: Four friends, Bara, Rafa, David and Momon celebrated their school farewell together. However, what if that togetherness turns out to be the last time?

title: 5 cm: Revolusi Hati
overview: Four inseparable companions pledge lifelong solidarity upon entering secondary education, only for their collective bond to undergo severe emotional and structural strain when the introduction of romantic interests and an transformative journey outside the metropolis force them to confront the inevitable realities of maturity.

title: Philosophy of the Porch
overview: A dedicated young woman serving as her family's primary financial provider finds her matrimonial aspirations permanently derailed when she uncovers a debilitating secret: their ancestral home was pawned by her late father to finance her eldest brother's opulent wedding.

title: Beneran Horor
overview: Joe, a film director, is shooting a horror movie on a remote island with his crew. A critical error, however, leads them to the wrong location—a mysterious territory inhabited by creatures that should never be disturbed. When Joe finds himself in need of extras, the crew encounters these "inhabitants," mistakenly believing they were summoned by Opie. Unsuspecting, the crew treats the creatures just like ordinary extras—until the situation takes a turn that is both tense and absurd.
